stories.text: Center fielder Dale Murphy wins the National League MVP Award, becoming the first Braves' player to be so honored since Hank Aaron in 1957. Murphy hit .281 with 36 home runs, 109 RBI, 113 runs, and 23 stolen bases.

stories.extract: The Major League Baseball Most Valuable Player Award (MVP) is an annual Major League Baseball (MLB) award given to one outstanding player in the American League (AL) and one in the National League (NL). stories.text: The 1992 Major League Baseball expansion draft was held on November 17, 1992, in New York City.
stories.headline: Expansion Draft Held in New York City
stories.extract: The 1992 Major League Baseball expansion draft was held on November 17, 1992, in New York City. The expansion draft allowed two expansion teams in Major League Baseball (MLB)—the Colorado Rockies and Florida Marlins—to build their rosters prior to their inaugural seasons.

stories.text: Major League Baseball holds an expansion draft to stock the rosters of the National League's two new teams, the Florida Marlins and Colorado Rockies. A total of 72 players are chosen. The best picks for Florida are Trevor Hoffman, eventually packaged for Gary Sheffield; Jeff Conine, and Cris Carpenter, later dealt to the Texas Rangers for Robb Nen.
stories.headline: Expansion Draft Stocks Marlins and Rockies With 72 Players

stories.text: National League magnates conclude a four-day meeting in Chicago where they agree to shorten the 1893 schedule to 132 games and drop the split season schedule (the league's next split season would be 1981). They also pledge to continue to reduce player salaries and other team expenses.
stories.headline: National League Owners Shorten 1893 Schedule to 132 Games
